service_description: The model receives speed, distance, relative speed, road friction, actuator delay, and expected state.
The model computes stopping distance and time-to-collision.
The model converts risk indicators into SAFE, CAUTION, WARNING, or EMERGENCY_BRAKE.
The model outputs brake_request = 1 only when the state is EMERGENCY_BRAKE.
The model compares actual and expected states and saves verification evidence.
